The University at Albany is home to leaders, doers and impact makers.
We believe in unleashing your individual potential, in setting the standard for inclusive excellence, and in learning and discovery for the betterment of all. For over 180 years we’ve been committed to seeing perseverance in the underestimated and promise in the unwavering. We’re not for the faint of heart, and we’re not a place for people afraid to pitch in. We’re the Great Danes and we unleash greatness.
